Quick operational bullets for the one-page workflow: 
- Triage: automated rules + confidence threshold produce an "investigate" alert in Ops queue (target median detection-to-queue: 4 mins).
- Human review: Level 1 reviewers (3pm-10pm PST) validate within SLA 4 hours, Level 2 (policy SME) within 24 hours for escalations.
- Escalation: critical tenant-impacting incidents roll to on-call infra and CSM within 30 mins.
- Appeals: customers can submit an appeal via Console or API; appeals routed to a reviewer and logged as an evidence bundle; target resolution 72 hours.

I'll include aggregated metrics: alert volume distribution, observed FP rate ~7.8% on broad-signal sets (rolling 90-day average), and median TTR (time-to-resolution) 16 hours for non-critical.

Ben
Support & Ops Lead, Redwood Inference

Subject: RFI response: telemetry signatures, human review & reporting — FinBridge

Sam / Priya — please find our consolidated response below and attached artifacts. We included an anonymized sample alert set and the telemetry signature catalog, plus our SOC2 Type II report. If you need tenant-identifiable exports we'll follow the addendum process.

Summary (high level):
- Telemetry signature catalog: We maintain a combined signature registry of heuristics and ML-derived indicators. Each signature includes id, name, type (heuristic/ml/hash), provenance (model version or ruleset), severity, confidence band, and TTL. Signatures are versioned; we publish changelogs to the customer Console and support portal.
- Detection & observability: Signals are emitted per-request; we aggregate into alert events for tenant reporting. We provide sample alert CSVs (attached) and a schema (attached). We can expose request-level hashes under NDA.
- Human review & escalation: automated triage -> Level 1 reviewer -> Level 2 policy SME -> on-call infra/CSM for criticals. SLAs: investigate-to-queue median 4 minutes, L1 response target 4 hours, L2/Policy 24 hours, appeals target 72 hours. Critical incidents notify within 30 minutes.
- Metrics & historical artifacts: attached are anonymized alert volumes (90-day distribution), rolling false-positive rate (7.8% for broad signals), and median time-to-resolution (16 hours). Tenant-specific metrics require addendum.
- Reporting & audit: we provide per-route and per-token cost/latency telemetry, audit logs for admin actions, and retention configuration for alerts and logs. SOC2 Type II report attached.

Attachments included in this email (stubs):
- RFI_Response_FinBridge_20261205.pdf (consolidated written responses + short diagrams)
- telemetry_signature_catalog.csv (id,name,type,provenance,severity,confidence,ttl,notes)
- sample_alerts_202611.zip (anonymized CSVs of alert events, schema included)
- SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf (attestation)

Related links: https://hubspot.example/deal/FB-2026-17 and a Drive folder with evidence: https://drive.example.com/finbridge/rfi_evidence

If useful we can set a 30-minute walkthrough next week to go over the telemetry catalog and sample alerts. Let me know what times work for your team.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
